component.summary: Brightness, contrast, gamma, warmth and saturation for every display

Яркость, контраст, гамма, температура и насыщенность для каждого экрана
Helligkeit, Kontrast, Gamma, Farbtemperatur und Sättigung für jeden Bildschirm

description.p: Display Tune gives every connected display its own brightness, contrast, gamma, color warmth and saturation, with a page per display and settings that follow the monitor to whichever port it is plugged into.

ul.li: Real hardware brightness: mutter's backlight for the laptop panel, DDC/CI for external monitors that support it, software dimming otherwise
Hardware contrast for monitors that support DDC/CI
Contrast, gamma and color warmth applied through the GPU gamma table: no flicker, no GPU cost, works in fullscreen games and video
Per-display saturation, including with several monitors at once, through a bundled GNOME Shell extension
Saved presets, copying settings between displays, and export/import
A Quick Settings toggle next to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
A test pattern for judging black level, white level, gamma and color balance
English, Arabic, Russian and German interface

screenshot.caption: Real hardware brightness and contrast for a supported external monitor
Quick Settings toggle, presets and brightness sliders

description.p: First release: per-display brightness, contrast, gamma, warmth and saturation, a Quick Settings toggle, presets, export/import, and an English/Arabic/Russian/ German interface.
